8055.about: A black-and-white ink illustration in the style of an old engraving. A large striped hot-air balloon floats among a few sketched clouds. A small man in a suit and tie hangs below it, holding the ropes with one raised hand while his legs dangle in the air. The balloon drifts gently up and to the side, and the man sways on the ropes. This is a balloon that is filled with hot air and can carry a person high into the sky.

english.question: What is the man doing?
english.answer: He is hanging from a big balloon.
